title: OpenClaw vs OpenAI Agents API: Which AI Agent Platform Wins?
summary: OpenClaw vs OpenAI Agents API compared: setup, pricing, model flexibility, and which one fits your workflow. Plus the managed option most readers end up choosing.
body_markdown: Token costs scale linearly. A busy production agent at 1,000 sessions/day on GPT-4o runs ~$90/month in API fees before infrastructure. At o1 rates ($15/$60 per 1M tokens), that same usage costs $450/month in LLM costs alone. OpenClaw lets you swap to cheaper models as costs grow; OpenAI Agents API locks you in.[Blink Claw](https://blink.new/claw) lets you switch models without code changes, with usage billed from your workspace credits.
